name: Josep Cruañes
headline: Software Developer | AI & Scientific Computing | Game Development
pitch: I build software for science and for play: machine learning and microscope automation at ICN2, with a background in game development.
about:
I'm a software developer and PhD researcher in the GAeN group at the Catalan Institute of Nanoscience and Nanotechnology (ICN2), where I develop AI-driven models and software for nanoparticle analysis and microscope automation.

I started in games. During my degree in Game Design and Development I worked as a programmer on team projects in Unity and Unreal, writing gameplay code in C# and C++, and I interned at the i3B institute (UPV) building minigames and world systems for the LEVEL-UP project.

A master's in Multidisciplinary Research in Experimental Sciences (BIST–UPF) carried that programming background into science: statistics, data analysis and machine learning applied to microscopy. I also hold a master's in Teacher Training, specialising in technology.
projects_intro: University game productions and a hardware build. On the games I worked as a programmer within a team; each page explains my part.
contact_intro: Have a question or want to talk about a project? Send me a message and I'll reply as soon as I can.
